description.en: Deletes a camera object (one created with CMND_LOAD_CAMERA or CMND_CREATE_CAMERA).

true if the object was deleted, false if it was not found.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: A camera animation for a match scene (real usage, from ev44010001.nut; the Shift-JIS object names are replaced by variables here)
